records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ125X owner's service manual lists cylinder bore 54.000–54.014 mm (2.1260–2.1265 in) (wear limit 54.064 mm (2.1285 in)), piston-to-cylinder clearance 0.040–0.045 mm (0.0016–0.0018 in), top ring end gap limit 1.20 mm (0.0472 in), and friction plate wear limit 2.80 mm (0.110 in).
records.notes: Two-stroke: no valve clearance or camshaft specs exist. Brake disc runout limit is as measured on the wheel. Drive chain slack is measured on the maintenance stand. Fuel level measured with fuel level gauge.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ125X owner's service manual schedules maintenance after break-in, every race (about 2.5 h), every third race (about 7.5 h) and every fifth race (about 12.5 h), with YAMALUBE 2R premix at the printed ratio 30, SAE 10W-40 transmission oil (0.66 L (0.70 US qt, 0.58 Imp.qt)) and an NGK BR9EVX plug gapped 0.6–0.7 mm (0.024–0.028 in).

records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ125X owner's service manual lists a liquid-cooled reed-valve 125 cm³ two-stroke, 54.0 × 54.5 mm (2.13 × 2.15 in), compression 7.4–8.8 : 1, with a TMXx38 carburetor (main jet #430, needle 6BFY43-74-3) and a 6-speed gearbox with 3.846 (50/13) final drive.
records.notes: Ignition timing is printed as a piston position B.T.D.C. (mm), not degrees.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ125X owner's service manual lists a 1455 mm (57.3 in) wheelbase, 26.8 ° caster, 116 mm (4.6 in) trail, 95 kg (209 lb) curb weight and 955 mm (37.6 in) seat height, with 300 mm fork / 315 mm rear travel, 4.1 N/mm fork and 46 N/mm shock springs.
records.notes: Spec-chapter fork oil 'Quantity' (425.0 cm³ (14.37 US oz, 14.99 Imp.oz)) differs from the tuning chapter's 'standard oil amount' (230 cm³ (7.8 US oz, 8.1 Imp.oz)), which is the adjustable amount used for air-spring tuning; both kept as printed. Spring free lengths for fork/shock are not printed (only the fork spring free length limit). Damper clicks are counted from the start position (0 = hard).

records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ125X owner's service manual lists standard TMXx38 jetting of main #430, pilot #40, needle 6BFY43-74 (clip No. 3 groove), and for general conditions above 30 °C recommends #420 / 6BFY44-74-2 / #37.5 / 2-1/4 (main/needle/pilot/air screw).

road condition examples (main jet / jet.pilot air screw TIP: Add the ex-factory number of pilot air screw back-out turns to the chart value (e.g. ex-factory 1 -> add 1).

values.needle family note: At the same clip number, 6BFY43-74 -> 6BFY42-74 equals lowering the clip 0.5 position; 6BFY43-74 -> 6BFY44-74 equals raising it 0.5 position. Main nozzle is non-disassembly, so tuning is by jet needle.

symptom guide.full throttle: stall at high speed, hard: Increase main jet calibration No. gradually
symptom guide.full throttle: speed pick-up stops, soot: Decrease main jet calibration No. gradually
symptom guide.1/4–3/4 throttle hard breathing / lack o: Lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down)
symptom guide.1/4–1/2 throttle slow pick-up, white smo: Raise jet needle clip position (1 groove up); if effective try a needle giving a 0.5 clip difference
symptom guide.closed–1/4 throttle hard breathing, spee: Use jet needle with smaller diameter
symptom guide.closed–1/4 throttle poor acceleration, w: Use jet needle with larger diameter
symptom guide.unstable at low speed, pinking: Lower clip 1 groove; turn in pilot air screw
symptom guide.poor response at extremely low speed: Reduce pilot jet calibration No.; turn out pilot air screw; if no effect reverse
symptom guide.poor response when throttle opened quick: Check overall settings; lower main jet; raise clip 1 groove; if no effect reverse

values.spark plug heat range: Standard BR9EVX (resistance type). If main jet must change by ±30, change plug heat range and reselect main jet; never change more than ±1 heat range; read plugs immediately after stopping.
values.test run plug reading: Dry, burnt-brown insulator = normal; whitish = over burned (too lean); sooty and wet = oil fouled (too rich).

records.notes: Atmospheric table is qualitative (temperature/humidity/air pressure -> richer/leaner); no altitude-specific jet numbers are printed. Road-condition table jet needle notation is needle-clip groove.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ125X owner's service manual lists fork springs from 3.9 to 4.7 N/mm (STD 4.1 N/mm) and shock springs from 42 to 56 N/mm (STD 46 N/mm) with 90–100 mm rider sag; no rider-weight bands are given.

values.rider-weight table: Not printed: Yamaha's YZ125X tuning chapter lists springs by rate (SOFT -> STIFF) only, with no rider-weight bands.

fork oil (tuning chapter).step: adjust in 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz) increments; oil amount changes damping/air-spring near final stroke

after fork spring change.softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks, compression in 1–2 clicks
after fork spring change.stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks, compression out 1–2 clicks

values.unequal-pitch note: Softer initial characteristic than equal-pitch and harder to bottom out.
values.after shock spring change: Reset sunken length 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in). Softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks; stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks; rebound changes also shift compression slightly (correct by decreasing compression).
values.standard shock length 'a': 490 mm (19.29 in); never fit a shock longer than standard
values.rider sag (sunken length a-b): 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in); a = rear axle to rear fender holding bolt with wheel off ground, b = same with rider astride

balance guidance.low front / tending to lower front postu: set sunken length 95–100 mm (3.7–3.9 in) (lower rear), or more fork oil 5 cm³, compression +2 clicks / rebound -2 clicks
balance guidance.obtrusive front / upper front posture: set sunken length 90–95 mm (3.5–3.7 in) (upper rear), softer fork spring, less fork oil 5–10 cm³, compression -2 clicks

values.adjustment increments (shock): rebound 2 clicks, low-speed compression 1 click, high-speed compression 1/6 turn

fork symptom fixes.stiff over entire range: compression out ~2 clicks; reduce oil 5–10 cm³; softer spring
fork symptom fixes.soft over entire range / bottoming: compression in ~2 clicks; add oil 5–10 cm³; stiffer spring
fork symptom fixes.poor initial movement: rebound out ~2 clicks; grease oil seals

shock symptom fixes.spongy and unstable: rebound in ~2 clicks; low compression in ~1 click; stiffer spring
shock symptom fixes.poor road gripping: rebound out ~2 clicks; low compression in 1 click; high compression in 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring
shock symptom fixes.bottoming out: high compression in 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; stiffer spring
shock symptom fixes.stiff travel: high compression out 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring

values.gearing guidance: Secondary ratio = rear teeth / drive teeth. Lower the ratio for long straights, raise it for tight courses; set for the course section with most effect on results and so the engine reaches max revs near the end of the longest straight without over-revving.

records.notes: Spring options are listed by rate and part number only; the manual gives no rider-weight recommendation. Standard gearing 13/50.

records.notes: Ignition timing is printed as a piston position B.T.D.C. (mm), not degrees.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2022 YZ125X owner's service manual lists a 1455 mm (57.3 in) wheelbase, 26.8 ° caster, 116 mm (4.6 in) trail, 95 kg (209 lb) curb weight and 955 mm (37.6 in) seat height, with 300 mm fork / 315 mm rear travel, 4.1 N/mm fork and 46 N/mm shock springs.

Spring free lengths for fork/shock are not printed (only the fork spring free length limit). Damper clicks are counted from the start position (0 = hard).

records.statement: Yamaha's 2022 YZ125X owner's service manual lists standard TMXx38 jetting of main #430, pilot #40, needle 6BFY43-74 (clip No. 3 groove), and for general conditions above 30 °C recommends #420 / 6BFY44-74-2 / #37.5 / 2-1/4 (main/needle/pilot/air screw).

road condition examples (main jet / jet.pilot air screw TIP: Add the ex-factory number of pilot air screw back-out turns to the chart value (e.g. ex-factory 1 -> add 1).

values.needle family note: At the same clip number, 6BFY43-74 -> 6BFY42-74 equals lowering the clip 0.5 position; 6BFY43-74 -> 6BFY44-74 equals raising it 0.5 position. Main nozzle is non-disassembly, so tuning is by jet needle.

symptom guide.full throttle: stall at high speed, hard: Increase main jet calibration No. gradually
symptom guide.full throttle: speed pick-up stops, soot: Decrease main jet calibration No. gradually
symptom guide.1/4–3/4 throttle hard breathing / lack o: Lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down)
symptom guide.1/4–1/2 throttle slow pick-up, white smo: Raise jet needle clip position (1 groove up); if effective try a needle giving a 0.5 clip difference
symptom guide.closed–1/4 throttle hard breathing, spee: Use jet needle with smaller diameter
symptom guide.closed–1/4 throttle poor acceleration, w: Use jet needle with larger diameter
symptom guide.unstable at low speed, pinking: Lower clip 1 groove; turn in pilot air screw
symptom guide.poor response at extremely low speed: Reduce pilot jet calibration No.; turn out pilot air screw; if no effect reverse
symptom guide.poor response when throttle opened quick: Check overall settings; lower main jet; raise clip 1 groove; if no effect reverse

values.spark plug heat range: Standard BR9EVX (resistance type). If main jet must change by ±30, change plug heat range and reselect main jet; never change more than ±1 heat range; read plugs immediately after stopping.
values.test run plug reading: Dry, burnt-brown insulator = normal; whitish = over burned (too lean); sooty and wet = oil fouled (too rich).

records.notes: Atmospheric table is qualitative (temperature/humidity/air pressure -> richer/leaner); no altitude-specific jet numbers are printed. Road-condition table jet needle notation is needle-clip groove.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2022 YZ125X owner's service manual lists fork springs from 3.9 to 4.7 N/mm (STD 4.1 N/mm) and shock springs from 42 to 56 N/mm (STD 46 N/mm) with 90–100 mm rider sag; no rider-weight bands are given.

values.rider-weight table: Not printed: Yamaha's YZ125X tuning chapter lists springs by rate (SOFT -> STIFF) only, with no rider-weight bands.

fork oil (tuning chapter).step: adjust in 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz) increments; oil amount changes damping/air-spring near final stroke

after fork spring change.softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks, compression in 1–2 clicks
after fork spring change.stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks, compression out 1–2 clicks

values.unequal-pitch note: Softer initial characteristic than equal-pitch and harder to bottom out.
values.after shock spring change: Reset sunken length 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in). Softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks; stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks; rebound changes also shift compression slightly (correct by decreasing compression).
values.standard shock length 'a': 490 mm (19.29 in); never fit a shock longer than standard
values.rider sag (sunken length a-b): 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in); a = rear axle to rear fender holding bolt with wheel off ground, b = same with rider astride

balance guidance.low front / tending to lower front postu: set sunken length 95–100 mm (3.7–3.9 in) (lower rear), or more fork oil 5 cm³, compression +2 clicks / rebound -2 clicks
balance guidance.obtrusive front / upper front posture: set sunken length 90–95 mm (3.5–3.7 in) (upper rear), softer fork spring, less fork oil 5–10 cm³, compression -2 clicks

values.adjustment increments (shock): rebound 2 clicks, low-speed compression 1 click, high-speed compression 1/6 turn

fork symptom fixes.stiff over entire range: compression out ~2 clicks; reduce oil 5–10 cm³; softer spring
fork symptom fixes.soft over entire range / bottoming: compression in ~2 clicks; add oil 5–10 cm³; stiffer spring
fork symptom fixes.poor initial movement: rebound out ~2 clicks; grease oil seals

shock symptom fixes.spongy and unstable: rebound in ~2 clicks; low compression in ~1 click; stiffer spring
shock symptom fixes.poor road gripping: rebound out ~2 clicks; low compression in 1 click; high compression in 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring
shock symptom fixes.bottoming out: high compression in 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; stiffer spring
shock symptom fixes.stiff travel: high compression out 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring

values.gearing guidance: Secondary ratio = rear teeth / drive teeth. Lower the ratio for long straights, raise it for tight courses; set for the course section with most effect on results and so the engine reaches max revs near the end of the longest straight without over-revving.

records.notes: Spring options are listed by rate and part number only; the manual gives no rider-weight recommendation. Standard gearing 13/50.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ125X owner's service manual lists cylinder bore 54.000–54.014 mm (2.1260–2.1265 in) (wear limit 54.064 mm (2.1285 in)), piston-to-cylinder clearance 0.040–0.045 mm (0.0016–0.0018 in), top ring end gap limit 1.20 mm (0.0472 in), and friction plate wear limit 2.80 mm (0.110 in).
records.notes: Two-stroke: no valve clearance or camshaft specs exist. Brake disc runout limit is as measured on the wheel. Drive chain slack is measured on the maintenance stand. PWK carburetor specifies float height instead of fuel level.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ125X owner's service manual schedules maintenance after break-in, every race (about 2.5 h), every third race (about 7.5 h) and every fifth race (about 12.5 h), with YAMALUBE 2R premix at the printed ratio 30, SAE 10W-40 transmission oil (0.70 L (0.74 US qt, 0.62 Imp.qt)) and an NGK BR9EVX plug gapped 0.6–0.7 mm (0.024–0.028 in).

records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ125X owner's service manual lists a liquid-cooled reed-valve 125 cm³ two-stroke, 54.0 × 54.5 mm (2.13 × 2.15 in), compression 7.8–10.2 : 1, with a PWK38S carburetor (main jet #160, needle NYCF-2) and a 6-speed gearbox with 3.846 (50/13) final drive.
records.notes: Ignition timing is printed as a piston position B.T.D.C. (mm), not degrees. Primary coil resistance is not printed in this manual.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ125X owner's service manual lists a 1455 mm (57.3 in) wheelbase, 26.4 ° caster, 111 mm (4.4 in) trail, 97 kg (214 lb) curb weight and 970 mm (38.2 in) seat height, with 300 mm fork / 315 mm rear travel, 4.2 N/mm fork and 48 N/mm shock springs.
records.notes: Spec-chapter fork oil 'Quantity' (475.0 cm³ (16.06 US oz, 16.75 Imp.oz)) differs from the tuning chapter's 'standard oil amount' (280 cm³ (9.5 US oz, 9.9 Imp.oz)), which is the adjustable amount used for air-spring tuning; both kept as printed. Spring free lengths for fork/shock are not printed (only the fork spring free length limit). Damper clicks are counted from the start position (0 = hard).

records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ125X owner's service manual lists standard PWK38S jetting of main #160, pilot #65, needle NYCF (clip No. 2 groove), and for general conditions above 25 °C recommends #158 / NYDE-2 / #58 / -1/8 (main/needle/pilot/air screw).

values.needle family note: Changing straight-portion diameter adjusts mixture at 1/8–1/4 throttle; changing taper starting position has the same effect as moving the clip 0.5 groove (example: 0.5 groove leaner than NYCF-2nd groove -> NYDF-2nd groove). Main nozzle is non-disassembly, so tuning is by jet needle.

road condition examples (main jet / jet.pilot air screw TIP: Values are relative: add the ex-factory number of pilot air screw back-out turns to the chart value.

symptom guide.full throttle: stall at high speed, hard: Increase main jet calibration No. gradually
symptom guide.full throttle: speed pick-up stops, soot: Decrease main jet calibration No. gradually
symptom guide.1/4–3/4 throttle hard breathing / lack o: Lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down)
symptom guide.1/4–1/2 throttle slow pick-up, white smo: Raise jet needle clip position (1 groove up); if effective try a needle giving a 0.5 clip difference
symptom guide.closed–1/4 throttle hard breathing, spee: Use jet needle with smaller diameter
symptom guide.closed–1/4 throttle poor acceleration, w: Use jet needle with larger diameter
symptom guide.unstable at low speed, pinking: Lower clip 1 groove; turn in pilot air screw
symptom guide.poor response at extremely low speed: Reduce pilot jet calibration No.; turn out pilot air screw; if no effect reverse
symptom guide.poor response when throttle opened quick: Check overall settings; lower main jet; raise clip 1 groove; if no effect reverse

values.spark plug heat range: Standard BR9EVX (resistance type). If main jet must change by ±30, change plug heat range and reselect main jet; never change more than ±1 heat range; read plugs immediately after stopping.
values.test run plug reading: Dry, burnt-brown insulator = normal; whitish = over burned (too lean); sooty and wet = oil fouled (too rich).

records.notes: Atmospheric table is qualitative (temperature/humidity/air pressure -> richer/leaner); no altitude-specific jet numbers are printed. Road-condition table jet needle notation is needle-clip groove. 2025-2026 column headers are garbled in extraction; order assumed identical to the 2024 manual, whose values match exactly.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ125X owner's service manual lists fork springs from 3.9 to 5.1 N/mm (STD 4.2 N/mm) and shock springs from 42 to 56 N/mm (STD 48 N/mm) with 90–100 mm rider sag; no rider-weight bands are given.

values.rider-weight table: Not printed: Yamaha's YZ125X tuning chapter lists springs by rate (SOFT -> STIFF) only, with no rider-weight bands.

fork oil (tuning chapter).step: adjust in 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz) increments; oil amount changes damping/air-spring near final stroke

after fork spring change.softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks, compression in 1–2 clicks
after fork spring change.stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks, compression out 1–2 clicks

values.unequal-pitch note: Softer initial characteristic than equal-pitch and harder to bottom out.
values.after shock spring change: Reset sunken length 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in). Softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks; stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks; rebound changes also shift compression slightly (correct by decreasing compression).
values.standard shock length 'a': 490 mm (19.29 in); never fit a shock longer than standard
values.rider sag (sunken length a-b): 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in); a = rear axle to 'mark' on rear fender with wheel off ground, b = same with rider astride

balance guidance.low front / tending to lower front postu: set sunken length 95–100 mm (3.7–3.9 in) (lower rear), or more fork oil 5 cm³, compression +2 clicks / rebound -2 clicks
balance guidance.obtrusive front / upper front posture: set sunken length 90–95 mm (3.5–3.7 in) (upper rear), softer fork spring, less fork oil 5–10 cm³, compression -2 clicks

values.adjustment increments (shock): rebound 2 clicks, low-speed compression 1 click, high-speed compression 1/6 turn

fork symptom fixes.stiff over entire range: compression out ~2 clicks; reduce oil 5–10 cm³; softer spring
fork symptom fixes.soft over entire range / bottoming: compression in ~2 clicks; add oil 5–10 cm³; stiffer spring
fork symptom fixes.poor initial movement: rebound out ~2 clicks; grease oil seals

shock symptom fixes.spongy and unstable: rebound in ~2 clicks; low compression in ~1 click; stiffer spring
shock symptom fixes.poor road gripping: rebound out ~2 clicks; low compression in 1 click; high compression in 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring
shock symptom fixes.bottoming out: high compression in 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; stiffer spring
shock symptom fixes.stiff travel: high compression out 1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring

values.gearing guidance: Secondary ratio = rear teeth / drive teeth. Lower the ratio for long straights, raise it for tight courses; set for the course section with most effect on results and so the engine reaches max revs near the end of the longest straight without over-revving.

records.notes: Spring options are listed by rate and part number only; the manual gives no rider-weight recommendation. Standard gearing 13/50.

conflicts.detail: Spec chapter lists fork oil 'Quantity' 425.0 cm³ per leg (2021-2022) / 475.0 cm³ (2023-2026) while the tuning chapter lists 'Standard oil amount' 230 cm³ (2021-2022) / 280 cm³ (2023-2026) with adjustment ranges; likely total vs adjustable outer-chamber amount, not reconciled in the extract.
